summary: Healthcare Triangle filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026 announcing a Separation and Distribution Agreement with its wholly-owned Teyame AI Holdings subsidiary to spin off a minority stake. HCTI will distribute Teyame shares pro rata to HCTI stockholders while retaining majority ownership; the distribution is expected to be taxable under IRC Sections 311(b) and 301. No price, ratio, premium, or closing month was disclosed. Watch for the record date, distribution ratio, minority stake size, and potential Nasdaq overhang from the new public Teyame shares.
